notes.title: Change of Plans
notes.content:
I don't like the way the new features currently work in the game, so I am going to make some improvements on them and also add some complementing features before releasing the Demo.
I will try to make it lean more toward the resource management side, instead of the current score earning side. I attempt to make the game more interactive this way, because I felt like it wasn't involving the player enough.

notes.title: Huge News
notes.content: I finished rewriting the necessary things. Some small functions will need to be added to the game before it is demo ready. Once I finish adding in the functions I will announce the demo on the store page, and you will also be able to see the demo on it's own store page if everything goes well. You can follow this store page for more info and updates.

notes.title: Demo for Unpinned, Changes to gameplay
notes.content: I decided to make a demo for Unpinned. I decided to keep the feel of the old version of the game intact but add something more to it, that I hope will make the game a better experience. I will update the store page when the changes will be complete. I will post an announcement when the date for the release of the demo will be certain.

notes.title: Improvements and Plans
notes.content:
Working on making a new game mode.
The new game mode is going to be more of a long term investment of effort unlike the short, round based system that the game currently has. Players would be able to spend more time on their map without having to start new runs. This new game mode doesn't affect the old game mode in any way, so those who will enjoy it more than the new mode will be able to continue playing it.

Menu bugs got fixed, except one that waits for publishing the changes.

Some lore inaccuracies got fixed, now waiting for publishing the changes.
